text.en: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

ANCIENT model only. This model has:
+1 OC and Ld.
Feel No Pain 5+.
The following ability:
Ancient Exhortation (Once per battle, per army): When this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit’s melee attacks have +1 A until the end of the phase.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
+1 S and AP.
Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP.
CAPTAIN model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has:
2+ Sv.
Feel No Pain 5+.
You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only.(Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, if you target a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit within 12" of this model with that stratagem, that use is -1 CP.
CAPTAIN model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.
You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED model only. This model’s ranged attacks (excluding [Psychic] attacks) have +1 A, S, AP and D.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only.
This unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits].
If the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, this unit can re-roll advance rolls.
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to charge rolls.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].
ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.
Friendly TACTICUS units can re-roll advance rolls.

TACTICUS model only. This unit’s attacks can:
Re-roll one hit roll.
Re-roll one wound roll.
TACTICUS model only. This unit has Scouts 6".
Friendly TACTICUS units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

TACTICUS model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.
TACTICUS model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

When a friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot:
Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

PHOBOS model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can:
Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

PHOBOS model only. In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly PHOBOS unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.
PHOBOS model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

PHOBOS model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can:
Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1-2.

In a turn a friendly GRAVIS unit made a normal move, that unit’s ranged attacks:
Do not have [Heavy].
Have +1 to hit rolls.
GRAVIS model only. Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
GRAVIS model only. This unit has Scouts 5".
While a friendly GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
GRAVIS unit only. This unit has +1 OC.
APOTHECARY BIOLOGIS model only. in your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +2" M.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES SPEEDER unit only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit is spotted:
While a unit is spotted, that unit has +3" detection range.
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
DREADNOUGHT unit only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 D.
DREADNOUGHT unit only. While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn:
While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. If this unit disembarked this turn:
This unit can re-roll charge rolls.
Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

CAPTAIN model only. In your Movement phase, if this unit is embarked within a TRANSPORT unit, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit within 6" of that TRANSPORT unit and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that INFANTRY unit.

Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units’ (excluding WALKER units) ranged attacks can:
Re-roll one hit roll.
Re-roll one wound roll.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit only (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units). This unit:
Has 5+ InSv.
At the end of your Command phase, heals 1 wound.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit only (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units). This unit’s ranged attacks have [Heavy].

Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:
Furor Tactics
If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Malleus Tactics
If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
Purgatus Tactics
If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].
DEATHWATCH ALLIES
You can include DEATHWATCH units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.
When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a DEATHWATCH model to be your WARLORD. In addition KILL TEAM units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.
This an exception to the Space Marine Chapters Army Rules.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a KILL TEAM unit, this unit has:
Deep Strike.
When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.
